b022_trace.a_producer: Stored source closure: TimelineCommitStore.revision_closure -> port._read -> _load -> bundle_from_document. Intermediate images: document_from_bundle -> project -> Closure; CommitPatch.before/after creates command input/output documents and bindings. b022_trace.b_reachability: All original9 share saved_closure and genuine registered Runtime path. Retained B003/B004 facts include successful initial canonical setup and source patch/reload: stored-source and canonical-document producers are necessary on that path. For the refused candidate, v2 multi-command execution calls before/after per command and attaches proof before preview/accept, provided compilation/handler/final validation succeed, v2 is active, >1 calls (or inverse stages) creates boundaries, and port/proof shape/context pass. Original/landing/history verification branch and refused ordinal/ref/path are not in the SAFE packet. Thus specific refused-image construction/attachment and actual promotion branch remain UNKNOWN, distinct from the proved existence/reach of earlier canonical source production.
b022_trace.c_required_step: No demonstrated public supported setup step is omitted. Real registration/initialization/source mutation/canonical reload/publisher path is present. C0 allows sequential commands in one transaction and requires provider-generated physical observations; it does not require the caller to inject raw records or precommit future operands. Exact skipped-step/D104 applicability is NOT_PROVED.
b022_trace.reconstruction_distinction: Guard boundary starts at images(source), then command_output projects authenticated earlier generated writes and creation allocations. Sequential private proof is checked separately; capture existence alone cannot establish that reconstructed result contains the refused ref.
